trajectory_summary: The call opens cold and mechanically procedural, but personal rapport (wrestling, Mormon banter, hometown ties) builds real warmth mid-call and carries the customer to a booked Saturday 8AM appointment. The rep never uses the bill amount or the customer's stated reason (bill pain/door-knocker skepticism) to reinforce urgency — the booking succeeds on likability, not on anchored value.
outcome_dispute: V1 tag is unknown; this call should be scored booked given the explicit day+time handshake at 10:41-10:45, though the bill photo was only promised, not delivered live, which affects fragility not the outcome tag.
